change_log.value: Clinical Trials Core Search Logic Implementation

FEAT-3-S80.title: Clinical Trials Input/Output Schema Definition
FEAT-3-S80.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for clinical trials search inputs (condition, location, recruiting status) and structured outputs including trial metadata, locations, and travel distance fields.

FEAT-3-S81.title: Clinical Trials Core Search Logic Implementation
FEAT-3-S81.description: Implement core service logic to query ClinicalTrials.gov with recruiting filter, extract trial locations, and compute travel distance and duration using Google Routes integration.

FEAT-3-S82.title: Clinical Trials API Response Formatting
FEAT-3-S82.description: Format clinical trials results into structured, LLM-consumable responses including trial summaries, eligibility highlights, and distance-aware sorting for downstream chat rendering.

FEAT-3-S83.title: Clinical Trials Service Tests
FEAT-3-S83.description: Create unit and integration tests for clinical trials search, including API response mocking, recruiting filter validation, and travel distance calculation accuracy.
